privacy:
✦ReplyMaxxing

ReplyMaxxing Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 20, 2026

ReplyMaxxing is a Chrome extension made by MPH Tech LLC, doing business as ReplyMaxxing ("we"). Its AI assistant, Max, helps you write LinkedIn messages, comments and posts. This policy explains what ReplyMaxxing reads, what we keep, and what we never do.

What ReplyMaxxing reads

ReplyMaxxing reads LinkedIn content only when you click one of its buttons (Ask Max on a profile, Suggest reply, Suggest comment, Check my inbox, or an Autopilot item):

  • The profile, conversation or post on your screen, to write your draft.
  • When you click Score profile, that profile's text and its banner and profile photo, to score it. When you click What's trending, the posts on your feed (author, text and reaction counts).
  • When you click Check my inbox, the list of conversations on your screen (names, last message preview and time), to show who to follow up with.

It never reads LinkedIn in the background, never sends or connects for you. The only click it makes is opening a chat you picked in Radar.

What we send and keep

  • Draft requests. The page text from your click is sent to our server and to our AI provider (Anthropic) only to write your draft. We do not store it.
  • Questions to Max. What you type to Max, plus a short note of which LinkedIn page you're on (for example "a profile named Jordan Lee"), is sent to our server and our AI provider only to answer you. We do not store it. Your chat with Max stays in your browser.
  • Your account. Your email, plan, billing status and usage counts. Payments are handled by Stripe; we never see your full card number.
  • Your setup answers, playbook and training. The details you enter about you and your goal (including, for job seekers, your target role and any gaps you choose to share), plus any writing samples, frameworks and rules you add in Voice & training, so Max can use them in your drafts on any computer. You can edit or remove them anytime in Settings.
  • Conversation counts. For Managed Inbox limits we keep a one way hash of each conversation, never names or message text.
  • Profile scores and images. Profile text, banner and photo are sent to our AI provider only to score the profile. We do not store them. Your reports stay in your browser.
  • Resumes and job posts (job seekers). Your resume is kept in your own Chrome profile. When you tailor or score it, or ask who to contact about a job, your resume and the job post you opened are sent to our server and our AI provider only to do that, and are not stored. We keep a hashed job ID and how many versions you made, to apply the credits. A PDF you upload is sent once to be turned into text.
  • Morning hiring alerts (job seekers). When you open your LinkedIn feed, the extension checks the posts already on your screen for hiring mentions in your browser; nothing from your feed is sent to us. On paid plans the web search for hiring posts uses only your target role and location from setup.
  • Free resume score on our website. We keep your email, the role you entered, your score and when you scored, to send you the result and job search tips (unsubscribe anytime). Your resume is read to score it and is not stored.
  • Layout health reports. If a ReplyMaxxing button can't find its place on LinkedIn (for example after a LinkedIn redesign), the extension sends a short code such as "feed_no_action_row", the extension version and the page language. No names, URLs or page content. We keep daily counts only, to fix breakages fast.

What stays in your browser

Your draft history, pipeline stages, inbox list from Radar, skip list and settings are stored in your own Chrome profile. Uninstalling the extension deletes them.

What we never do

We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

Your choices

You can delete your account and data at any time by emailing brian@mphtechacademy.com. You can cancel your plan in the billing page.

Contact

MPH Tech LLC, brian@mphtechacademy.com
